text: ABITypeMapper in mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABITypeMapper.h maps mlir::Type into the LLVM ABI library (llvm/lib/ABI). Dialects implement ABIRewriteContext (mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABIRewriteContext.h); CIR's is CIRABIRewriteContext in clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/TargetLowering/CIRABIRewriteContext.cpp, driven by the CallConvLowering pass in clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/CallConvLoweringPass.cpp.
